name: Arcsan POS de Mostrador
author: ARMANDO GERARDO ARCAUTE VAZQUEZ

sections.description:
Arcsan POS de Mostrador is a free point-of-sale plugin for businesses that sell in person while using WooCommerce as their product, customer, order, and inventory system.

Features include:

  • Visual product search by name, SKU, or barcode.
  • A counter cart with editable product prices.
  • Discounts, full payments, and partial payments.
  • Additional payments for existing receipts.
  • A recent receipt panel inside the POS workspace.
  • Receipt notes retrieved from WooCommerce orders and compatible WCPOS data.
  • Customizable 58 mm and 80 mm thermal receipts with order number, payment status, notes, visual editor, HTML template editor, and reprinting.
  • Register opening and closing sessions with an opening float, expected cash, and payment-method totals.
  • A focused checkout workspace for cashiers.
  • A My Account menu entry that gives authorized cashiers direct access to the POS.

An optional commercial Pro edition is available from Arcsan for businesses that need multiple warehouses, advanced inventory movements, additional roles and reports, refunds, migration tools, licensing, and commercial updates. The free plugin remains fully functional without the Pro edition.

This plugin is independently developed by Arcsan and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the WooCommerce project.

Upgrade to Pro

Learn about the optional annual license for Tienda POS Pro:

https://arcsan.mx/tienda/producto/licencia-anual-tienda-pos-pro/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the arcsan-pos-de-mostrador folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Arcsan POS from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the register, receipt, and printer settings before starting a checkout session.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Products, customers, orders, prices, and inventory are managed through WooCommerce.

Is the free edition time-limited?

No. The free edition does not expire and its included features do not require a license.

Can I print thermal receipts?

Yes. The receipt designer supports 58 mm and 80 mm layouts and browser-based printing.

Where can I get the Pro edition?

The optional Pro license is sold by Arcsan at https://arcsan.mx/tienda/producto/licencia-anual-tienda-pos-pro/.
sections.changelog:
0.1.5

  • Replaced legacy internal identifiers with the unique Arcsan POS de Mostrador prefix.

0.1.4

  • Removed the restricted integration name from the public plugin display name.

0.1.3

  • Renamed the plugin with the distinctive Arcsan identifier.
  • Added English directory documentation.
  • Loaded embedded styles and the receipt designer through the WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Added strict schema-based sanitization for cart JSON and related request data.

0.1.2

  • Preserved line breaks and spacing in receipt notes and adjusted printed receipt height to its content.

0.1.1

  • Added the receipt designer, HTML template editor with variables, and live preview.

0.1.0

  • Initial free release with counter checkout, receipts, installments, and cashier access.
